# signal — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Smart money / whale / KOL signal tracking. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl signal <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### signal chains
Get supported chains for market signals
`ocl signal chains`

### signal list
Get latest signal list (smart money / KOL / whale activity)
`ocl signal list --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--wallet-type <WALLET_TYPE>` — Wallet type filter: 1=Smart Money, 2=KOL/Influencer, 3=Whales (comma-separated, e.g. "1,2")
- `--min-amount-usd <MIN_AMOUNT_USD>` — Minimum transaction amount in USD
- `--max-amount-usd <MAX_AMOUNT_USD>` — Maximum transaction amount in USD
- `--min-address-count <MIN_ADDRESS_COUNT>` — Minimum triggering wallet address count
- `--max-address-count <MAX_ADDRESS_COUNT>` — Maximum triggering wallet address count
- `--token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Token contract address (filter signals for a specific token)
- `--min-market-cap-usd <MIN_MARKET_CAP_USD>` — Minimum token market cap in USD
- `--max-market-cap-usd <MAX_MARKET_CAP_USD>` — Maximum token market cap in USD
- `--min-liquidity-usd <MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD>` — Minimum token liquidity in USD
- `--max-liquidity-usd <MAX_LIQUIDITY_USD>` — Maximum token liquidity in USD
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor — pass the cursor from the last item of the previous page
